plan: To preserve capital, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and other holdings flagged for exit (METU, MUU, SMCI).
QQQI will be trimmed to 20% to reduce concentration and address the trim flag.
SPY will be increased to 25% to boost broad index exposure and stability.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a large cash buffer.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged positions and concentrating on stable, broad market exposure. Expect lower volatility and more consistent, albeit smaller, gains.

plan: We will trim SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 1%, METU to 3%, and MUU to 2% to reduce overall leverage and exposure to downtrending positions.
SMCI will be sold entirely due to its below-stop status and downtrend.
QQQI will be trimmed to 20% to address concentration and the trim flag.
New positions in TXN (4%) and AAPU (4%) will be initiated, leveraging strong scanner setups to add quality tech exposure.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing new, high-quality scanner setups. Expect moderate volatility and a blend of broad market stability with targeted growth opportunities.

plan: We will increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL to 6%, SPAL to 6%) and existing leveraged tech (METU to 6%, MUU to 6%) to lean into growth.
SMCI will be sold due to its below-stop status and downtrend, adhering to strict stop discipline.
QQQI will be trimmed to 15% to free up capital for higher-growth opportunities.
New positions in TXN (6%) and AAPU (6%) will be initiated, concentrating in the strongest scanner setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth, stretching for higher returns. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-beta tech, which amplifies both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware of daily decay in leveraged ETFs and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to. This mode carries substantially higher risk.

plan: To prioritize yield, all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and high-beta positions flagged for exit (METU, MUU, SMCI) will be sold.
QQQI will be increased to 30% to boost monthly distributions.
SPY will be increased to 30% to provide stable broad market exposure.
CRWD will be trimmed to 5% to reduce exposure to high-beta single names, aligning with an income focus.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It significantly reduces exposure to leverage and high-beta names, favoring income-generating ETFs and broad market exposure. While aiming for steady distributions, remember that NAV can still fall in a selloff, and distributions are variable, not guaranteed.
